---
applyTo: "control_server/frontend/**"
---

## Contribution guidelines

- UI serves as almost the docs for users to understand the features of the control server, ensure UI is designed with thought of how features are to be used and presented
- Apply consistent design patterns and components across the UI
- Ensure responsiveness and usability across MANY different devices and screen sizes (mobile, tablet, desktop, large monitors)
- Polling is a bad practice, use SSE for real-time updates where possible
